entries.title: Launch Announcement (Cinematic Trailer)
entries.usedFor: Legends of Runeterra launch announcement cinematic
entries.background: A CG cinematic animated by Unit Image and directed by Ben Hibon that announced the full launch of Legends of Runeterra about four weeks before the game left beta on 30 April 2020. The upload credits the studio and director but names no composer, and its score has never been released as a separate track.

entries.title: Breathe (Legends of Runeterra Version)
entries.background: Riot's music team remixed 'Breathe', the 2019 song by Tommee Profitt and Fleurie, for the launch of Legends of Runeterra. The new version scores the official launch video, a Unit Image cinematic directed by Ben Hibon starring Cithria, Darius and Zed, which premiered on 30 April 2020 as the game went live on PC and mobile. It came out the same day as a single credited to Fleurie and Legends of Runeterra.

entries.title: K/DA Beats for Lo-fi Legends
entries.usedFor: K/DA ALL OUT event lo-fi mix
entries.background: A roughly six-minute mix of lo-fi K/DA beats that the Legends of Runeterra channel posted for its K/DA ALL OUT event, which added a K/DA game board, a Lab mode, K/DA Epic Spells and an event pass to the card game. Riot pitched it as relaxed background music for deckbuilding and ranked play; the event's K/DA board plays arrangements of POP/STARS, THE BADDEST and MORE.

entries.title: Beyond the Bandlewood (Cinematic Trailer)
entries.background: First episode of a three-part Sun Creature story about Ava, made for Beyond the Bandlewood, the August 2021 expansion that brought Bandle City to Legends of Runeterra as its final region. The tale continued in the Magic Misadventures (November 2021) and A Curious Journey (February 2022) trailers; none of the episodes credit a composer or have a released score.

entries.title: Predator (World Ender Remix)
entries.usedFor: Anthem of the World Ender expansion
entries.background: Mark Evans remixed Pentakill's 'Predator' from Lost Chapter (2021), originally written with Tre Watson and TELLE, as the anthem of World Ender, the December 2022 Legends of Runeterra expansion that closed The Darkin Saga. The LoR channel released it as official audio branded for its Worlds 2022 season, and it came out as a single on streaming services the same day.

entries.title: Shine On
entries.usedFor: Heart of the Huntress expansion song
entries.background: Song by Brain Tan featuring Abigail Osborn, produced with Woolly Music for Riot Games Music to promote Heart of the Huntress, the June 2023 Legends of Runeterra expansion. It samples 'Pulse' by Dilip and Neeko's champion theme 'Neeko, the Curious Chameleon', and premiered as an official audio visualizer alongside a single release.

entries.title: Dance Into the Dark
entries.background: Song made by Riot Games Music with The Crystal Creative for Fate's Voyage: Beyond, the December 2023 Legends of Runeterra update, released the day before the game's 2023 World Championship. Mark Evans composed it and wrote the lyrics with vocalists Chandler Leighton, Tommy Will and BigBreeze, building it on a sample of Riot's 'Coven' music. It was published as an audio visualizer; no streaming single was found.

Penelope Aretos was music director with Riot Games Music supervising, and the track was released as a single the same day.

entries.title: Roo's Lantern
entries.usedFor: Spirit Blossom: First Bloom & Afterglow cinematic
entries.background: Two-part animated tale about Roo and his lantern, made with Eddy.tv for Legends of Runeterra's 2025 Spirit Blossom events. Part 1 debuted for Spirit Blossom: First Bloom in August 2025 and the full cinematic followed in September for Spirit Blossom: Afterglow. Hillel Teplitzki composed the music, sung by Stephanie Olmanni and produced and mixed by Nir Shor.
